name: Strongman Simulator
desc:
💪Welcome to Strongman Simulator! 💪

🦆 Drag items across the line to gain energy,
⚡ Use energy at the gym to gain strength,
💨 Remove the exit to reach new areas.

⭐ Premium players earn 10% more energy ⭐

🚨 Limited Event until 19th October 🚨
🐔 Train to take on the boss in a brand new level inspired by Crunchyroll's Anime Monster Collector.
📺 Get a free trial of Crunchyroll and link your Roblox account in game for additional rewards!
